marker: # A template for `scholion import-labs <file>`. Delete these comment lines before use.
# marker   — the name of the test in any language the dictionary knows
#            `scholion markers` lists what is already in your profile; an unknown
#            name is refused with suggestions rather than creating a second series.
# date     — YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM.
# value    — a number. A comma decimal mark is understood.
# unit     — required for a test that is not yet in your profile. A non-canonical
#            unit is converted (mg/dL → mmol/L and so on); an unrecognised one is
#            refused with the list of accepted spellings.
# ref_low  — the lower reference bound printed on your form. Optional
# ref_high   converted along with the value.
# note     — free text.
# The file is imported whole or not at all: one bad row and nothing is written.
# Check first with `scholion import-labs <file> --dry-run`.
